_note: Calgary Insight pronunciation list for Kokoro (studio-probe probe/tts.py). Key = word exactly as written in the script (case-sensitive, whole word); say = respelling Kokoro reads instead. Bow.why: Bow River / The Bow rhymes with 'go', not 'cow'
